## TemplateManager.getDescriptionScopes() method

Gets available scopes for a description.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getDescriptionScopes(key: string, baseId?: string): string[];
```

## Remarks

Useful for determining which scopes are defined for a command.

## Example


```typescript
const scopes = tm.getDescriptionScopes("start", "default")
// => ["default", "admin"]
```
